text.en: PBDB records Apateon flagrifer (Whittard 1930) at species rank. Its recorded parent is Apateon. Its classification follows the database snapshot of 2 October 2026. This supplementary path does not assert equivalence with similarly named COL entries.

text.en: The exact PBDB concept has 7 returned occurrence records, representing 7 collection IDs. Recorded modern geographic labels include DE / Thuringia; DE / Thüringia; DE / Thuringia / Gotha District. The supplied interval labels are Asselian; Sakmarian; Autunian. The outer bounds of the returned collection age intervals are 298.9–283.3 million years ago. These are database age bounds for collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date. The query is a database snapshot, not evidence of a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 这一确切 PBDB 概念返回 7 条出现记录，涉及 7 个采集地 ID。记录的现代地理标签包括 DE / Thuringia；DE / Thüringia；DE / Thuringia / Gotha District。来源提供的年代区间标签为 Asselian；Sakmarian；Autunian。这些采集地年代区间的外侧边界为距今 298.9–283.3 百万年；这是数据库中的采集地年代边界，不能当作测定的物种起源或灭绝时间。查询仅代表本次数据库快照，不能证明全球化石分布已被完整记录。

text.en: The exact PBDB concept has 24 returned occurrence records, representing 23 collection IDs. Recorded modern geographic labels include US / Texas; US / Texas / Baylor; US / Texas / Archer; US / Oklahoma / Noble; US / Oklahoma / Kay; US / Oklahoma / Grant; US / Oklahoma / Cotton; US / Texas / Baylor/Willbarger; US / Texas / Knox; US / Texas / Taylor; US / Oklahoma / Jefferson; US / Oklahoma / Tillman. The supplied interval labels are Wolfcampian; Artinskian–Kungurian; Kungurian; Asselian–Sakmarian; Artinskian; Leonardian; Permian. The outer bounds of the returned collection age intervals are 298.9–251.902 million years ago. These are database age bounds for collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date. The query is a database snapshot, not evidence of a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 这一确切 PBDB 概念返回 24 条出现记录，涉及 23 个采集地 ID。记录的现代地理标签包括 US / Texas；US / Texas / Baylor；US / Texas / Archer；US / Oklahoma / Noble；US / Oklahoma / Kay；US / Oklahoma / Grant；US / Oklahoma / Cotton；US / Texas / Baylor/Willbarger；US / Texas / Knox；US / Texas / Taylor；US / Oklahoma / Jefferson；US / Oklahoma / Tillman。来源提供的年代区间标签为 Wolfcampian；Artinskian–Kungurian；Kungurian；Asselian–Sakmarian；Artinskian；Leonardian；Permian。这些采集地年代区间的外侧边界为距今 298.9–251.902 百万年；这是数据库中的采集地年代边界，不能当作测定的物种起源或灭绝时间。查询仅代表本次数据库快照，不能证明全球化石分布已被完整记录。

text.en: PBDB records Chelotriton robustus Westphal 1979 at species rank. Its recorded parent is Chelotriton. Its classification follows the database snapshot of 2 October 2026. This supplementary path does not assert equivalence with similarly named COL entries.

text.en: The exact PBDB concept has 1 returned occurrence records, representing 1 collection IDs. Recorded modern geographic labels include DE / Rheinland-Pfalz. The supplied interval labels are MP 28. The outer bounds of the returned collection age intervals are 27.3–23.04 million years ago. These are database age bounds for collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date. The query is a database snapshot, not evidence of a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 这一确切 PBDB 概念返回 1 条出现记录，涉及 1 个采集地 ID。记录的现代地理标签包括 DE / Rheinland-Pfalz。来源提供的年代区间标签为 MP 28。这些采集地年代区间的外侧边界为距今 27.3–23.04 百万年；这是数据库中的采集地年代边界，不能当作测定的物种起源或灭绝时间。查询仅代表本次数据库快照，不能证明全球化石分布已被完整记录。

title.en: Honeycomb-like sculpture distinguishes the cited robustus material
title.zh: 蜂窝样雕纹区别所引 robustus 材料

text.en: The paper describes robustus as having honeycomb-like sculpture across bones exposed to the skin, contrasting with predominantly pustular relief in most other Chelotriton material. Its vertebral spine tables are cited as wide plates with pits and very fine pustules. MB.Am.45 combines mostly pustular surfaces with a more honeycomb-like maxillary region; that mixture is not a robustus identification. These are literature-based comparative features, not a new population sample or measurements of skin itself. The authors leave the developmental significance of the sculpture differences uncertain.
text.zh: 论文描述 robustus 与皮肤接触骨面为蜂窝样雕纹，与多数其他 Chelotriton 主要瘤状浮纹对照。其椎骨神经棘顶板引述为带凹窝及细小瘤点的宽板。MB.Am.45 结合多数瘤状骨面及较蜂窝样颌骨区，不是 robustus 鉴定。这些是文献比较特征，不是新种群样本或皮肤本身测量。作者保留雕纹差异发育意义不确定。

title.en: Ossified wrists are a cited comparison, not a growth curve
title.zh: 骨化腕部是引述比较而非生长曲线

text.en: Robustus is among the taxa cited as having ossified wrist elements, alongside other fossil and living newts. The observation does not determine an age at ossification, developmental rate or complete digit formula for the species. Its relatively small honeycomb-sculptured vertebrae are contrasted with larger pustular vertebrae assigned paradoxus, but body-size differences cannot alone resolve ontogeny or species boundaries. MB.Am.45’s humerus, ulna and radius lengths remain with that unassigned specimen rather than being copied to robustus.
text.zh: robustus 与其他化石及现生蝾螈一起，被引述有骨化腕部；该观察不确定骨化年龄、发育速率或本种完整指骨式。其较小蜂窝雕纹椎骨与较大、归 paradoxus 的瘤状椎骨对照，但体型差异本身不能解决个体发育或种界。MB.Am.45 的肱骨、尺骨、桡骨长度保留在未归种标本，不能复制给 robustus。

text.en: The exact PBDB concept has 11 returned occurrence records, representing 11 collection IDs. Recorded modern geographic labels include DE; RO / Arad; FR; DE / Baden-Württemberg / Heidenheim; AT; PL / Silesia; DE / North Rhine-Westfalia / Rhein-Sieg; AT / Burgenland; RU / Adygea / Maykop District; UA / Khmel'nitsk'yi / Shepetivka. The supplied interval labels are MN 5; Sarmatian; Chattian; Langhian–Serravallian; MP 30; MN 11; Late Miocene; Vallesian. The outer bounds of the returned collection age intervals are 27.3–5.333 million years ago. These are database age bounds for collections, not a measured species origin or extinction date. The query is a database snapshot, not evidence of a complete global fossil distribution.
text.zh: 这一确切 PBDB 概念返回 11 条出现记录，涉及 11 个采集地 ID。记录的现代地理标签包括 DE；RO / Arad；FR；DE / Baden-Württemberg / Heidenheim；AT；PL / Silesia；DE / North Rhine-Westfalia / Rhein-Sieg；AT / Burgenland；RU / Adygea / Maykop District；UA / Khmel'nitsk'yi / Shepetivka。来源提供的年代区间标签为 MN 5；Sarmatian；Chattian；Langhian–Serravallian；MP 30；MN 11；Late Miocene；Vallesian。这些采集地年代区间的外侧边界为距今 27.3–5.333 百万年；这是数据库中的采集地年代边界，不能当作测定的物种起源或灭绝时间。查询仅代表本次数据库快照，不能证明全球化石分布已被完整记录。

title.en: A familiar species label conceals unresolved fossil assignments
title.zh: 熟悉种名之下有未解决化石归属

text.en: The 2015 paper challenges earlier placement of the Orsberg specimen MB.Am.45 in paradoxus and retains it as Chelotriton sp. Comparisons distinguish neotype-locality material from Enspel and Randeck skeletons traditionally assigned the same name. Thus the 18-by-35-mm skull, extreme posterior jaw joints and forelimb lengths of MB.Am.45 are not paradoxus measurements. The database concept remains retained for navigation, while original specimen identity requires a separate revision. The article’s arguments do not establish a newly named species or complete the reconciliation of every database occurrence.
text.zh: 2015 年论文质疑此前将 Orsberg 标本 MB.Am.45 放入 paradoxus，保留为 Chelotriton sp.。比较将新模产地材料与传统归入同名的 Enspel、Randeck 骨骼分开。因此 MB.Am.45 十八乘三十五毫米头骨、极后移颌关节及前肢长度不是 paradoxus 测量。数据库概念保留导航，原标本身份仍需独立修订。论文论证没有建立新命名物种，也未完成每条数据库出现记录核对。

title.en: Neotype-locality comparisons have their own anatomical scope
title.zh: 新模产地比较有自身解剖范围

text.en: The source cites two to four processes per rib in paradoxus material from the neotype locality and an approximately 30–35° orientation of a frontal process to the sagittal plane. Those are comparative reports from particular material, not a universal adult diagnosis or directly remeasured specimens here. The paper records uncertain or variable vertebral and cranial characters across the genus, including preservation-dependent differences. It does not transfer the genus diagnosis’s body-length range or MB.Am.45’s incomplete wrist and digit anatomy to every paradoxus fossil.
text.zh: 来源引述 paradoxus 新模产地材料每肋二至四突，以及额骨突相对矢状面约三十至三十五度方向。这是特定材料比较报告，不是通用成体诊断，也不是这里直接重测标本。论文记录属内不定或可变椎骨、头骨性状，含保存相关差别。不能将属诊断体长范围或 MB.Am.45 不完整腕指解剖转移至每个 paradoxus 化石。

title.en: Historical metamorphosis interpretations were revised for referred material
title.zh: 归入材料的历史变态解释曾修订

text.en: Some skeletons traditionally called paradoxus were earlier interpreted as having a fully metamorphosed hyobranchial apparatus; later cited work interpreted Enspel and Randeck material as retaining larval components. The 2015 discussion uses this as a comparative mosaic-development example. It does not demonstrate that every paradoxus population was paedomorphic, establish a larval duration or measure breeding biology. Because the same paper questions several species assignments, developmental interpretation and the recorded name must remain separate evidence fields.
text.zh: 传统称 paradoxus 的一些骨骼，较早被解释为舌鳃装置完全变态；后来引述研究将 Enspel、Randeck 材料解释为保留幼体部分。2015 年讨论将其用于比较镶嵌发育实例，没有证明每个 paradoxus 种群幼态保持、确定幼体年限或测繁殖生物学。论文同时质疑多个种级归属，因此发育解释与记录名称应保留为独立证据。

title.en: The 2020 study labels its paradoxus association tentative
title.zh: 2020 年研究将 paradoxus 关联标为暂定

text.en: Seven Enspel fossils and one Randeck fossil were tentatively associated with paradoxus, following cited earlier work. Their differing skull shapes prompted the suggestion that the deposits may contain different species, and the authors state that named Chelotriton species await validation. Consequently, the study’s pooled fossil shape and size comparisons cannot be certified as a single paradoxus population trait. This preserves the earlier 2015 concerns about historical assignments rather than silently treating a later citation as final identity confirmation.
text.zh: 依引述较早工作，Enspel 七个、Randeck 一个化石暂与 paradoxus 关联。不同头骨形状促成两地点或含不同种的建议，作者记具名 Chelotriton 种仍待验证。因此所合并化石形状及大小比较不能认证为单一 paradoxus 种群性状。这保留 2015 年对历史归属的疑问，不把较晚引用悄然当作最终身份确认。

title.en: Deposit ages and reconstructed skulls have distinct evidence roles
title.zh: 沉积年代与重建头骨具有不同证据角色

text.en: The cited 24.8–24.6-million-year Enspel interval and 17–15-million-year Randeck interval date the sampled deposits. They do not show continuous occupation by one species between those ages. Shape analysis included estimated missing landmarks and symmetrization of distorted Enspel fossils, and post-hoc comparisons omitted the single Randeck sample. Palaeoclimate and terrestrial-life interpretations belong to the comparative study, not independently established paradoxus thermal limits or directly preserved reproductive behaviour.
text.zh: 引述 Enspel 24.8–24.6 百万年及 Randeck 十七至十五百万年区间是所采沉积年代，不证明同一种在两年代间连续占据。形状分析包含缺失标志点估计及变形 Enspel 化石对称化，事后比较排除 Randeck 单样本。古气候及陆生解释属于比较研究，不是独立建立的 paradoxus 耐温或直接保存繁殖行为。

heading.en: A familiar species label conceals unresolved fossil assignments
heading.zh: 熟悉种名之下有未解决化石归属

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC4589347 XML sec009 paragraph 2; sec020 paragraphs 0–4, 8

evidenceSummary.en: The 2015 paper challenges earlier placement of the Orsberg specimen MB.Am.45 in paradoxus and retains it as Chelotriton sp. Comparisons distinguish neotype-locality material from Enspel and Randeck skeletons traditionally assigned the same name. Thus the 18-by-35-mm skull, extreme posterior jaw joints and forelimb lengths of MB.Am.45 are not paradoxus measurements. The database concept remains retained for navigation, while original specimen identity requires a separate revision. The article’s arguments do not establish a newly named species or complete the reconciliation of every database occurrence.
evidenceSummary.zh: 2015 年论文质疑此前将 Orsberg 标本 MB.Am.45 放入 paradoxus，保留为 Chelotriton sp.。比较将新模产地材料与传统归入同名的 Enspel、Randeck 骨骼分开。因此 MB.Am.45 十八乘三十五毫米头骨、极后移颌关节及前肢长度不是 paradoxus 测量。数据库概念保留导航，原标本身份仍需独立修订。论文论证没有建立新命名物种，也未完成每条数据库出现记录核对。

heading.en: Neotype-locality comparisons have their own anatomical scope
heading.zh: 新模产地比较有自身解剖范围

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC4589347 XML sec007 paragraphs 5–7; sec014 paragraphs 1–2; sec020 paragraphs 1, 7

evidenceSummary.en: The source cites two to four processes per rib in paradoxus material from the neotype locality and an approximately 30–35° orientation of a frontal process to the sagittal plane. Those are comparative reports from particular material, not a universal adult diagnosis or directly remeasured specimens here. The paper records uncertain or variable vertebral and cranial characters across the genus, including preservation-dependent differences. It does not transfer the genus diagnosis’s body-length range or MB.Am.45’s incomplete wrist and digit anatomy to every paradoxus fossil.
evidenceSummary.zh: 来源引述 paradoxus 新模产地材料每肋二至四突，以及额骨突相对矢状面约三十至三十五度方向。这是特定材料比较报告，不是通用成体诊断，也不是这里直接重测标本。论文记录属内不定或可变椎骨、头骨性状，含保存相关差别。不能将属诊断体长范围或 MB.Am.45 不完整腕指解剖转移至每个 paradoxus 化石。

heading.en: Historical metamorphosis interpretations were revised for referred material
heading.zh: 归入材料的历史变态解释曾修订

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC4589347 XML sec013 paragraph 3; sec019 paragraph 4; sec020 paragraphs 4, 9

evidenceSummary.en: Some skeletons traditionally called paradoxus were earlier interpreted as having a fully metamorphosed hyobranchial apparatus; later cited work interpreted Enspel and Randeck material as retaining larval components. The 2015 discussion uses this as a comparative mosaic-development example. It does not demonstrate that every paradoxus population was paedomorphic, establish a larval duration or measure breeding biology. Because the same paper questions several species assignments, developmental interpretation and the recorded name must remain separate evidence fields.
evidenceSummary.zh: 传统称 paradoxus 的一些骨骼，较早被解释为舌鳃装置完全变态；后来引述研究将 Enspel、Randeck 材料解释为保留幼体部分。2015 年讨论将其用于比较镶嵌发育实例，没有证明每个 paradoxus 种群幼态保持、确定幼体年限或测繁殖生物学。论文同时质疑多个种级归属，因此发育解释与记录名称应保留为独立证据。

heading.en: The 2020 study labels its paradoxus association tentative
heading.zh: 2020 年研究将 paradoxus 关联标为暂定

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC7369190 section 0 paragraph 0; section 5 paragraph 3; XML joa13201-sec-0008 paragraphs 0–1

evidenceSummary.en: Seven Enspel fossils and one Randeck fossil were tentatively associated with paradoxus, following cited earlier work. Their differing skull shapes prompted the suggestion that the deposits may contain different species, and the authors state that named Chelotriton species await validation. Consequently, the study’s pooled fossil shape and size comparisons cannot be certified as a single paradoxus population trait. This preserves the earlier 2015 concerns about historical assignments rather than silently treating a later citation as final identity confirmation.
evidenceSummary.zh: 依引述较早工作，Enspel 七个、Randeck 一个化石暂与 paradoxus 关联。不同头骨形状促成两地点或含不同种的建议，作者记具名 Chelotriton 种仍待验证。因此所合并化石形状及大小比较不能认证为单一 paradoxus 种群性状。这保留 2015 年对历史归属的疑问，不把较晚引用悄然当作最终身份确认。

heading.en: Deposit ages and reconstructed skulls have distinct evidence roles
heading.zh: 沉积年代与重建头骨具有不同证据角色

sectionEvidence.locator: PMC7369190 section 1 paragraph 1; section 2 paragraph 0; XML joa13201-sec-0009 paragraph 1; joa13201-sec-0012 paragraphs 2–3

evidenceSummary.en: The cited 24.8–24.6-million-year Enspel interval and 17–15-million-year Randeck interval date the sampled deposits. They do not show continuous occupation by one species between those ages. Shape analysis included estimated missing landmarks and symmetrization of distorted Enspel fossils, and post-hoc comparisons omitted the single Randeck sample. Palaeoclimate and terrestrial-life interpretations belong to the comparative study, not independently established paradoxus thermal limits or directly preserved reproductive behaviour.
evidenceSummary.zh: 引述 Enspel 24.8–24.6 百万年及 Randeck 十七至十五百万年区间是所采沉积年代，不证明同一种在两年代间连续占据。形状分析包含缺失标志点估计及变形 Enspel 化石对称化，事后比较排除 Randeck 单样本。古气候及陆生解释属于比较研究，不是独立建立的 paradoxus 耐温或直接保存繁殖行为。

text.en: PBDB records Chelotriton ogygius Goldfuss 1831 at species rank. Its recorded parent is Chelotriton. Its classification follows the database snapshot of 2 October 2026. This supplementary path does not assert equivalence with similarly named COL entries.
text.zh: PBDB 将 Chelotriton ogygius Goldfuss 1831 记为 species 级，所记父级为 Chelotriton。分类依据 2026 年 10 月 2 日的数据库快照。这条补充路径不声明与 COL 中同名条目等同。

text.en: The dated query returned no occurrence with this exact accepted tid. This records a bounded database retrieval result, not absence of fossils or absence of published research. The taxonomic entry and its bibliography remain available for further study.
text.zh: 这次有日期的查询没有返回与该接受 tid 完全一致的出现记录。这是限定数据库检索的结果，不表示不存在化石或发表研究；分类条目和书目仍可用于进一步核对。

title.en: An apparently lost type limits comparison at Orsberg
title.zh: 模式似已遗失，限制 Orsberg 比较

text.en: The 2015 authors state that ogygius came from the same locality as MB.Am.45, but comparison is hampered by the apparent loss of its type and only known specimen. The old specimen was illustrated in ventral view, whereas MB.Am.45 preserves dorsal anatomy. Shared locality is therefore not proof of shared species identity, and MB.Am.45’s new cast is not a replacement ogygius type. The bounded empty occurrence query in the database reader does not erase this historical literature record; neither source proves a complete geographic or temporal range.
text.zh: 2015 年作者记 ogygius 与 MB.Am.45 来自同一地点，但模式及唯一已知标本似已遗失，限制比较。旧标本图为腹面，MB.Am.45 保存背面解剖。共享地点不证明同种，新 MB.Am.45 翻模也不是替代 ogygius 模式。数据库读本限定查询未返出现记录，不消除这一历史文献记录；二者都不证明完整地理或时间范围。

title.en: A historical vertebral count is an estimate from incomplete material
title.zh: 历史椎骨数是部分材料估计

text.en: The paper recounts an older estimate of twelve presacral vertebrae for ogygius: the first ten were preserved, with presumed sacral and proximal tail vertebrae separated by a gap. This remains a historical reconstruction, rather than a new verified count or invariant species character. Other Chelotriton material was reported with different sacral positions, and the authors note vertebral variation even among living salamanders. Without comparable type material, the 2015 study neither resolves ogygius identity nor supplies its feeding, reproduction or growth chronology.
text.zh: 论文转述 ogygius 较早荐前椎十二枚估计：前十枚保存，推定荐椎及近端尾椎之间有缺口。这是历史重建，不是新核实计数或恒定物种性状。其他 Chelotriton 材料有不同荐椎位置报告，作者提醒现生蝾螈也有椎数变化。缺少可比模式材料，2015 年研究未解决 ogygius 身份，也未提供取食、繁殖或生长年代。
